description: NFT metadata. tokenURI and resolved JSON metadata (name, description, image, attributes) for an ERC-721 or ERC-1155 token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism. IPFS/Arweave resolved. Example output: {"chain":"base","contract":"0x…","tokenId":"1","tokenUri":"ipfs://…","metadata":{"name":"…","image":"ipfs://…","imageUrl":"https://ipfs.io/ipfs/…","attributes":[]}}. Price: $0.007 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
